data.one_liner: Lat/long to timezone mapper in Dart without web services or data files.
data.what_it_does: Maps latitude and longitude coordinates to a timezone identifier in Dart. It uses hardcoded polygon mappings internally and relies on system libraries for offsets and daylight savings updates.
use_when: You need to determine the timezone from geographic coordinates locally
You want to avoid external web service calls for timezone lookups
You want to avoid bundling large external data files
avoid_when: You need frequent upstream polygon updates that are not yet ported
You require complex timezone boundary calculations beyond the hardcoded polygons
strengths: Does not require external data files
Delegates daylight savings and offsets to system libraries
weaknesses: Relies on hardcoded polygon mappings that require manual updates from upstream
Limited documentation and examples provided in README
